record.question: A very famous university in India which came to an end in 1193 AD, recently revived with the Special Act of Parliament, 2010 is
record.explanation: Answer A: Nalanda University. Nalanda University is the institution revived through the Nalanda University Act 2010. Its own institutional history and the parliamentary committee report identify the revival. The precise medieval destruction date is debated and should not be asserted as settled merely because the question prints 1193. Historical/source note: Nalanda is uniquely identified by the 2010 Act; retain 1193 as printed without treating the exact medieval date as independently established. Reference: https://nalandauniv.edu.in/about-nalanda/history-and-revival/; https://prsindia.org/files/bills_acts/bills_parliament/2013/Standing%20Committee%20Report%20_3.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
